bib.title: The Flan Collection: Designing Data and Methods for Effective Instruction Tuning

question: Which design decisions in the Flan 2022 instruction tuning collection and recipe account for its advantage over other public instruction tuning collections?
hypothesis: The authors expected a trade-off between zero-shot and few-shot performance when mixing prompt settings in training (particularly for small models); they found the opposite.
contributions: Show that training with mixed zero- and few-shot prompts yields much better performance in both settings (Section 3.2).
Measure critical techniques: scaling tasks (3.3), input inversion (3.4), chain-of-thought training data, and balancing data sources (3.5).
Demonstrate these choices yield 3-17% Held-Out task improvements over existing open source instruction tuning collections (Figure 1).
Demonstrate Flan-T5 is a stronger and more computationally-efficient starting checkpoint for single-task finetuning (Section 4).
Open source the Flan 2022 task collection, templates and methods.

method.summary: Ablates the Flan 2022 recipe by finetuning prefix-LM-adapted T5-LM XL (3B) on the Flan 2022 collection with one component removed at a time, and on rival public collections (Flan 2021, P3++, Super-Natural Instructions). Further runs vary the few-shot template fraction, the number of tasks and model size, and test Flan-T5 vs T5 as a starting point for single-task finetuning.

limits: Instruction tuning only: the paper studies no human feedback or RLHF, and cites the alignment tax of human feedback tuning only as motivation for its scope.
Mixture weights were set by leave-one-source-out ablation plus practitioner intuition; the authors leave more sophisticated search to future work.
Task scaling assumes all tasks counted equally; authors caution that gains beyond 1800 tasks need task diversity and quality.
No dedicated experiments isolate template variety versus OPT-IML's differences; comparison with OPT-IML relies on its reported numbers.
Experiments used a slightly earlier version of the released collection.
Instruction tuning hyperparameters (optimizer, lr, steps, batch, hardware) are deferred to Chung et al. 2022; results are single runs for ablations with no variance reported.
Only T5-family XL models were ablated; not evaluated on open-ended or human preference tasks.
